# World Vision UK

> World Vision UK is an international children's charity providing emergency aid, poverty relief, child protection, and sponsorship programs across vulnerable communities globally.

World Vision UK operates across multiple regions including Africa, the Middle East, and Asia, addressing child poverty, protection, and humanitarian crises. The organization combines direct aid delivery with community engagement through sponsorship, fundraising, volunteering, and advocacy campaigns.

## Key Topics

- Child protection
- Child sponsorship
- Emergency response
- Humanitarian aid
- Disaster relief
- Child poverty
- Sudan crisis
- Middle East appeal
- Afghanistan earthquake
- Fundraising
- Volunteering
- Child labour
- Child trafficking
- Clean water
- Advocacy campaigns

## Core Programs & Work

- [Our work helping children](https://www.worldvision.org.uk/our-work): Overview of World Vision UK's global work protecting vulnerable children.
- [Child Protection Initiatives](https://www.worldvision.org.uk/our-work/child-protection): Child protection initiatives addressing exploitation, trafficking, and child marriage in Bangladesh.
- [Ending Child Poverty](https://www.worldvision.org.uk/our-work/child-poverty): Poverty relief work in Kenya and Turkana tackling root causes of child poverty.
- [Emergency Response](https://www.worldvision.org.uk/our-work/emergency-response): Emergency response and disaster relief services in Afghanistan, Sudan, and the Middle East.

## Active Emergency Appeals

- [Sudan Appeal](https://www.worldvision.org.uk/emergencies/sudanappeal): Sudan crisis appeal providing life-saving aid including clean water, medical care, and food.
- [Middle East Emergency Appeal](https://www.worldvision.org.uk/emergencies/middle-east-appeal): Middle East emergency appeal supporting children in Lebanon and West Bank.
- [East Afghanistan Earthquake Appeal](https://www.worldvision.org.uk/emergencies/east-afghanistan-earthquake-appeal): Afghanistan earthquake appeal providing emergency aid to affected families.

## Child Sponsorship Programs

- [Sponsor a Child](https://www.worldvision.org.uk/sponsor-a-child): Child sponsorship program in Ethiopia providing water, food, education, and safety.
- [Chosen™ Sponsorship](https://www.worldvision.org.uk/sponsor-a-child/chosen): Chosen sponsorship innovation in Uganda empowering children to choose their sponsors.

## Ways to Give & Support

- [Donate to help children today](https://www.worldvision.org.uk/donate): Main donation page supporting children's protection globally.
- [Charity Gift Catalog](https://www.worldvision.org.uk/donate/buy-a-charity-gift): Charity gift catalog supporting children and families in hardest-hit countries.
- [Leave a Gift in Your Will](https://www.worldvision.org.uk/gifts-in-wills): Legacy giving program allowing charitable gifts in wills to World Vision.
- [Give in Memory](https://www.worldvision.org.uk/give-in-memory): Memorial giving program celebrating loved ones through donations and tribute funds.

## Get Involved & Volunteer

- [How to Fundraise](https://www.worldvision.org.uk/get-involved/fundraise): Fundraising guide for Global 6K for Water, school, and corporate campaigns.
- [Event Volunteers & Charity Volunteering](https://www.worldvision.org.uk/get-involved/volunteer): Charity volunteering guide for events and community involvement.
- [Volunteer at Charity Events](https://www.worldvision.org.uk/get-involved/events): Event volunteering guide for Christian festivals and charity events.

## Advocacy & Community

- [Campaigns for Change](https://www.worldvision.org.uk/support/campaign): Activism and advocacy campaigns on period poverty, climate, and school meals.
- [Pray for Others Around the World](https://www.worldvision.org.uk/support/pray): Prayer community and Together Amen prayer requests for served communities.
- [Post Your Pad for IWD 2026](https://www.worldvision.org.uk/get-involved/postyourpad): Post Your Pad campaign for International Women's Day addressing period poverty.

## Optional

- [International Children's Charity | World Vision UK](https://www.worldvision.org.uk): World Vision UK homepage: international children's charity supporting vulnerable children globally.
